```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```
```{r}
song_summary <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  group_by(artist, track, date.entered) |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best_rank = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    arrange(first_week_at_best_rank, artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "Fastest to #1"),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    arrange(desc(first_week_at_best_rank), artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "Slowest to #1"),
  song_summary |>
    filter(best_rank <= 10) |>
    arrange(desc(weeks_on_chart), artist, track) |>
    slice_head(n = 1) |>
    mutate(notable = "Longest top-10 chart run")
) |>
  select(
    notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank,
    first_week_at_best_rank, weeks_on_chart
  )

notable_songs |>
  print(width = Inf)
```
```{r}
top_10_songs <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank)) |>
  inner_join(
    song_summary |> filter(best_rank <= 10),
    by = c("artist", "track", "date.entered")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    notable_songs |>
      transmute(
        artist,
        track,
        highlight = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")
      ),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  )

ggplot(
  top_10_songs,
  aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track, date.entered))
) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top_10_songs, is.na(highlight)),
    color = "gray70",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top_10_songs, !is.na(highlight)),
    aes(color = highlight),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Chart ranking",
    color = "Notable songs"
  )
```
```{r}
billboard |>
  summarize(
    across(
      c(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76),
      list(
        missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x)),
        present = \(x) sum(!is.na(x))
      )
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("week", "status"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "rankings"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = rankings)
```
